parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json;const id=String(r['Prospect ID']||'').trim(),email=String(r.Email||'').trim().toLowerCase();if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}$/.test(id)||!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email)||!String(r.Company||'').trim()||!String(r['Service Offer']||'').trim())throw Error('Require unique alphanumeric Prospect ID, Company, Email and truthful Service Offer');if(String(r.Status||'').trim())return [];return [{json:{prospectId:id,company:String(r.Company).trim(),contact:String(r['Contact Name']||'').trim(),email,website:String(r.Website||'').trim(),observation:String(r['Relevant Observation']||'').trim(),service:String(r['Service Offer']).trim(),proof:String(r['Proof Point']||'').trim(),booking:String(r['Booking Link']||'').trim(),autoSend:/^(yes|true)$/i.test(String(r['Auto Send']||'').trim())}}];

const p=$('Validate prospect').first().json;let d;try{d=JSON.parse($input.first().json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content||'')}catch{throw Error('Invalid Groq JSON')}if(typeof d.subject!=='string'||typeof d.message!=='string'||!d.subject.trim()||!d.message.trim()||d.message.length>1600)throw Error('Missing or oversized draft');return [{json:{...p,subject:d.subject.trim().replace(/\s+/g,' '),message:d.message.trim()}}];

parameters.content:
## Connect your accounts
Choose your spreadsheet and Prospects tab in every Sheets node. Connect Google Sheets Trigger, Google Sheets, Gmail, Groq Header Auth, and Telegram credentials. Set YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in both message nodes, the Telegram callback trigger, and Authorize draft send. Allow gmail.googleapis.com in the Gmail OAuth credential for the approved-draft HTTP Request. Activate only after configuration.

## Cold email
A new prospect row creates a personalized first email. Sent time and status are saved in the Prospects sheet.

## Reply notification and draft
Every two minutes, check the inbox for a new reply to a sent email. Notify Telegram, then save one proposed reply in Gmail. The reply offers the time from the sheet when a future slot is provided.

## Review and send
Read the drafted reply in Gmail and use the Telegram button to send that exact saved draft. The button only works for the newest reply draft. This workflow does not book a meeting.

parameters.jsCode: const cb=$('Telegram approval buttons').first().json.callback_query||{};const chat=String(cb.message?.chat?.id||'');if(chat!=='YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID')return [];const match=/^outreach_send:([A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}):([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)$/.exec(String(cb.data||''));if(!match)return [];const row=$input.all().map(x=>x.json).find(r=>r['Prospect ID']===match[1]);if(!row||row['Last Reply ID']!==match[2]||row.Status!=='Reply draft ready'||!row['Reply Draft ID'])return [];return [{json:{prospectId:match[1],draftId:row['Reply Draft ID'],email:row.Email}}];
